role: Test-target fixed time zones (UTC and America/New_York) without force-unwrapping TimeZone(identifier:).
types: TestTimeZone: enum — static fixture time zones
toplevel: Two static lets: utc falls back to .gmt (same zero offset) and newYork falls back to .gmt if the tz database lacks the identifier. No functions.

flags.text: newYork silently falls back to GMT, which has no DST; the suites that use it to test wall-clock behaviour across a DST boundary would then run without the boundary and pass or fail misleadingly with no message.
